# Test Fixtures

All fixtures in this directory are generated by this toolchain itself
(`generator` field: `kicad-json5`) and are safe to redistribute.

| File | What it exercises |
| --- | --- |
| `battery-power-board.kicad_sch` | Rendering a toolchain-generated schematic |
| `battery-power-board-auto-layout.json5` | JSON5 → auto-layout → render, in-process |

## Optional: HQ EDA demo files

Some `#[ignore]`d integration tests additionally render real-world
schematics from the HQ EDA (华秋 EDA) online ECAD viewer demo set
(the same files ecad-viewer demos). These files are **not redistributable**
and are therefore not committed. Download them from the HQ EDA demo page and
place them into a directory of your choice, then run:

```sh
KICAD_DEMO_DIR=/path/to/dir cargo test -- --ignored
```

If the variable is unset, the default lookup path is `../example_sch`
(the layout used during development).
